doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-039 requires GET /health/ to return HTTP 2xx with sub-second latency and no external dependencies. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — normal GET /health/ returns exactly 200; (2) negative NEG — wrong method POST /health/ returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — latency must be strictly < 1000 ms (testing the sub-second threshold); (4) DT — verifying the response body is well-formed JSON with no external-dependency fields; (5) NEG — wrong path GET /health (no trailing slash) to confirm routing precision. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant-mutation and comparison-flip mutants.

tests.executable:
import time
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_health_latency_sub_second():
    client = TestClient(app)
    start = time.monotonic()
    r = client.get('/health/')
    elapsed_ms = (time.monotonic() - start) * 1000
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert elapsed_ms < 1000

test_health_latency_sub_second()

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_health_response_body_is_json():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/health/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert len(body) > 0

test_health_response_body_is_json()
